events.title: Anthropic Claude 2 released
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude 2 on July 11, 2023 with a 100K-token context window, improved coding, and a public beta chat interface.
events.about: Claude 2 competed directly with ChatGPT and GPT-4 on reasoning and long documents — analyzing entire books or codebases in one prompt. It expanded Anthropic's [API] and consumer chat products before the Claude 3 family arrived.

narrative.whyChosen: Claude 2 made long-context LLMs a mainstream product feature.
narrative.whyImportant: It validated 100K-token windows for legal, research, and code review workflows.
narrative.problemSolved: Earlier models could not fit full documents or large repos in a single conversation.

events.title: Meta Llama 2 open weights released
events.summary: Meta released Llama 2 on July 18, 2023 — open-weight large language models (7B, 13B, 70B) free for research and commercial use.
events.about: Llama 2 let startups and researchers run capable LLMs on their own hardware without OpenAI [API] bills. It spawned fine-tuning ecosystems (Hugging Face, Ollama, vLLM) and proved open weights could approach closed-model quality.

narrative.whyChosen: Llama 2 was the open-weights inflection point for self-hosted AI.
narrative.whyImportant: Commercial licensing of strong open models changed who could ship LLM products.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams lacked permissively licensed models competitive with proprietary APIs.
